scope: Six agreed bounded static supplements only; no publication, product/source/game mutation, new broad census, whole grappling downstream or whole-game completeness claim.

value.summary: 8373:0/8374:0 offhand mechanic7 input → UseOffHand → selected aim → direct grappling request/state writes, bounded before downstream grappling movement.

conditions.rule: Both exact active authorings have mechanic7=GrapplingHook; converter copies mechanicValue, minMaxTime and mechanicMultiplier. Authored mechanicValue is 7 for8373 and10 for8374, minMaxTime approximately0.1..0.6; no extra range inferred from mechanicMultiplier.

UseOffHand_HeldDown must be set; CurrentStateAllowInteractions must pass for SecondInteract_HeldDown && !Interact_HeldDown. Explicitly reject Release, MinecartRiding, Fishing, BoatRiding, VehicleRiding, UseOffHand and MountRiding. The offhand slot must be non-None, unbroken, resolve a prefab with non-None/non-Bait OffHandCD and have no unelapsed running offhand cooldown.

CurrentStateAllowInteractions rejects restricted guest mode (guestMode && adminPrivileges<1), spawning/release/death/teleport and non-idle sleep; Sitting, PlayingInstrument, vehicle/mount and secondary-use slot rules follow the referenced method.

costs.rule: Entering starts offHandCooldownTimer from prefab CooldownCD, fallback0.5 seconds. Exact active CooldownAuthoring values are8373≈0.8s and8374≈0.6s; this cost starts before hit success. No mana/item/durability debit is present in this bounded input/Enter/StartGrapplingRoutine path.

flow.rule: GrapplingHook pushes UseOffHand instead of SetNextState. Enter stores selected objectID/variation and sets useGrapplingNextUpdate; Update clears the flag before invoking StartGrapplingRoutine.

Keyboard/mouse uses normalizesafe(aimDirection). Pad starts from adjustedMovementVelocity, overrides it with aimDirection when wasAiming, uses facingDirection only if resulting length is zero, then normalizes.

Request resolves stored hook prefab and mechanicValue, obtains current/history collision worlds, constructs the offset-adjusted grapplingDirection, then calls tile, world, enemy-stop and enemy-pushback helpers. These are exact direct helper calls; their full downstream behavior is outside this record.

results.rule: Regardless of didHit, method starts grapplingTimer using lerp(minMaxTime, closestWalkableTileDistance/mechanicValue), writes hook position/distance/hitState and increments grapplingUseIndex. didHit sets Success or DidNotReachWallSuccess after walkable-distance comparison and permits activeRoutine=Grappling.

failures.rule: No held input, blocked interaction/state, invalid/broken/unsupported offhand or cooldown returns before push. A pressed button during cooldown records lastPressedOnCooldownTick before return; that write alone does not prove a queued retry.

NothingHit leaves hit state NothingHit and does not newly set activeRoutine=Grappling; Update requests Walk when the resulting active routine is none of Shielding/Dashing/Grappling. Failed hit still follows the timer/position/index writes and already-started cooldown.

boundary.rule: Completion here means the static direct request and field writes only. PlayerGrapplingRoutine travel/collision/end, helper internals, successful traversal, runtime DB/physics and network outcome are not claimed. Do not apply this mechanic7 rule to every offhand.

value.judgmentGapPrevented: From either hook item, distinguish a usable input/aim request, cooldown rejection and NothingHit from a successful traversal; gear equip alone cannot provide that distinction.

value.summary: Lightning9135:0 exact first aim and chain buffer selection with conditional chain attacks; existing common beam/cost/health behavior reused.

conditions.rule: Before PlayerAttackSystem, clear PlayerChainTargetsBuffer. Continue only for ObjectID.LightningGun, held amount>0, Interact_HeldDown, neither VehicleRiding nor MountRiding, CurrentStateAllowInteractions(false), and a BeamWeaponCD on equipmentPrefab. The interaction method includes guest/state/sleep rules.

Preserve actual hitWall state: Execute initializes it once before the3-iteration loop; GetCollisionFromOverlapChained sets the ref flag true on any sampled wall and never resets it for each candidate or each subsequent hop. A prior wall therefore can suppress later candidate assignments; do not replace this with an idealized nearest-visible-target algorithm.

costs.rule: Target/chain selection itself contains no new mana/durability debit. Reuse beam attack activation: ConsumeAnyRequiredMana, calculated item cooldown, QueueHit and beam active timer. Source authored cooldown≈0.2s; shared beam source-specific cost/availability and damage consumers remain conditional, and selection alone does not prove that activation or payment occurred.

flow.rule: Take source weapon damage from reinforced/level prefab when present (fallback1). Use history worlds at interpolation Delay and zero delay. Beam start uses SpecialWeaponHandler; normalize targetingDirection; initial endpoint=start+direction*5+(0,0.25,0), filter selected by pvpEnabled.

Cast rays in delayed then zero-delay worlds, each helper accepting only matching UseLagCompensation presence, excluding self and ground tile entities. Player branch uses faction attack permission; other first hits exclude pets/minions. Select smaller hit fraction. If no hit, sphere-cast radius1 along original endpoint, with same rules plus forward dot>0. Then sample wall tiles at0.2 spacing and write PlayerAimPosition.position/isHittingSomething.

If firstHitEntity is nonnull add its position, then at most3 iterations overlap within5 of previous position in both worlds. Candidate must match lag-compensation branch, be EnemyCD or permitted PlayerGhost, have HealthCD>0 and LocalTransform, be nonself and not already targeted. Compare squared hit-position distances, sample walls to candidate transform, and append chosen transform position.

results.rule: PlayerAimPosition is updated even when no first entity exists (possibly wall endpoint); chain buffer remains empty without a first entity. With a first entity buffer contains first target plus up to3 distinct chosen chain positions.

Only newly selected chain targets receive this method’s AttackHelper.Attack request, when cooldown.GetElapsedTicks(currentTick)==1 and !isPartialTick; parameter attacker=player, attackOffset=targetTransform-playerPosition+0.5up, radius0.1, damage/playerDamage=num, predicted and beforePhysics true. It does not set isRanged in this parameter initializer. The first target damage uses existing beam path.

failures.rule: Inactive item/input/state or missing BeamWeaponCD returns after clearing chain buffer. Missing firstHitEntity returns after aim write. No eligible next entity breaks chain. Walls, repeated/self/dead/missing-transform targets or incompatible lag/faction reject candidate; cooldown/partial tick suppress this method’s attack request without suppressing selected positions.

boundary.rule: Ray and sphere helpers differ from chain helper: a first nonpet/nonminion collision is not necessarily a healthy EnemyCD. Wall tile endpoint update does not clear firstHitEntity. Selection/buffer/AttackHelper request is static evidence, not observed hit/health success. Existing beam node supplies shared payment/activation and actual health/tile consumers.

value.judgmentGapPrevented: From9135, expose aim-only and chain-position results separately from cooldown-gated attacks and reused beam costs, preventing a selected chain from being treated as damage already dealt.

flow.rule: Active SupportsConditionsAuthoring supplies initialConditions; active AreaLevelAuthoring invokes seeded LevelToConditionValues before ConditionsBuffer insertion. Authored values are not unconditional runtime summaries.

Summarization is chunk order/change gated; it clears summary arrays and includes own ConditionsBuffer except ordinary conditions of a buffsOwner pet. Converter ensures initially disabled HasAuraConditionCD when environment-affectable; SummarizeConditionsSystem toggles that component from direct nonzero aura IDs including206. Therefore each exact active source has the component route to aura registration after eligible summary; no Effect0 consumer is invented. Level converter uses direct ID206 base (enemy:round(level*2), otherwise GetRadioactiveDamageOverTime(level)), multiplier/deviation/divisor; authored values remain inputs.

Nearby EntityPart is resolved to main entity. Skip disabled Simulate nonminions, missing aura receiver buffer and enabled DisablePhysics. ID206 counts as enemy-affecting; registration calls ShouldAffectWithAura(emitterFaction, receiverFaction, ..., receiver), whose enemy branch calls CanAffectEnemyWithAura(emitterFaction, receiverFaction, receiver): emitter faction must CanAttack receiver faction and receiver cannot be Merchant/Critter. Receiver update calls CanAffectEnemyWithAura(receiverFaction, emitterFaction, receiver): receiver faction must CanAttack emitter faction and receiver cannot be Merchant/Critter. This call direction differs from registration (emitterFaction, receiverFaction, receiver); do not assume symmetry. With that update predicate and receiver HealthCD, read each retained source’s summary[206]; keep maximum positive value (not sum). An entry supplying no applicable aura values is removed. When max206>0 and receiver summary243==0, always AddOrRefreshCondition207 AuraRadioactiveDamageOverTime(value=max206,multiplier1); only when RadioActiveConditionCD is disabled, enable it and call GetOrCreateTickTimer. An already enabled flag skips this aura-application timer call.

results.rule: When no positive206 or receiver243 immunity is nonzero, always RemoveCondition207; only when RadioActiveConditionCD is enabled, disable it and call RemoveTickTimer. An already disabled flag skips this aura-removal timer call. These are direct aura application/removal outcomes; shared victim immunity/tick consumer remains reused.
